The first implementation is in place. It selects the latest current medicine snapshot, preserves home wall-clock times, and prefers device readings when a nearby typed entry matches. I’m checking dose parsing and correction behavior next, including empty replacement lists and retractions.

Implemented [out/transform.ts](out/transform.ts). Strict harness and 56 tests pass.

Judgment calls: latest current medicine snapshot wins; diary notes and dose logs don’t create diagnoses or medication states. Patient-entered strengths and wall times are preserved. Ambiguous doses and product-level RxNorm codes are omitted. Matching typed/device readings within two minutes prefer the device copy.
